نستأتي (form X)
# نَسْتَأْتِي (nastaʔtī) /nas.taʔ.tiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
# نَسْتَأْتِيَ (nastaʔtiya) /nas.taʔ.ti.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْتَى (istaʔtā)
